Package org.frc5010.common.drive.swerve

Class GenericSwerveModuleInfo

java.lang.Object
org.frc5010.common.drive.swerve.GenericSwerveModuleInfo
public class GenericSwerveModuleInfo extends Object
Mutable container for swerve module telemetry — reused each cycle to avoid per-call allocation. Use update(Module) / update(SwerveModule) to refresh values in-place.
